articles.summary: PORTLAND, Ore., Aug. 11, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Pixelworks, Inc. (NASDAQ: PXLW) (" Pixelworks " or the "Company"), a provider of innovative cinematic and enhanced visualization solutions, today announced financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026.
articles.title: Pixelworks Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
